## Summary

Analyzed 23 changed files from the Live Chip-Table UI integration (round 2 re-review). Documentation quality is high — all major components and exported functions have accurate JSDoc. Two minor gaps found.

## Key Findings

### Files with full JSDoc coverage (all exported symbols documented):
- `core/state.ts` — 9 factory functions, all with @param/@returns ✓
- `core/state-serializer.ts` — buildPayload and saveState ✓
- `ui/auto-preview.ts` — 3 exported functions ✓
- `ui/three-row-header.tsx` — ThreeRowHeader, ThreeRowHeaderCustomParams ✓
- `ui/join-key-pair.tsx` — JoinKeyPair, JoinKeyPairProps ✓
- `ui/join-options-popup.tsx` — JoinOptionsPopup, JoinOptionsPopupProps ✓
- `ui/band-config-modal.tsx` — BandConfigModal, BandConfigModalProps ✓
- `ui/layout-modal.tsx` — LayoutModal, LayoutModalProps ✓
- `ui/stacks-modal.tsx` — StacksModal, StacksModalProps ✓
- `ui/grid.tsx` — All exported functions/interfaces ✓
- `ui/sheet-accordions.tsx` — SheetAccordions + internal helpers ✓
- `ui/top-section.tsx` — TopSection with both file-level and function JSDoc ✓
- `ui/pivot-sidebar.tsx` — Detailed JSDoc including collapse behavior ✓
- `types.ts` — All 15+ exported interfaces/types documented ✓

### Minor gaps:
1. **`FilterModalProps`** (filter-modal.tsx:12) — exported interface without JSDoc. Fields are obvious (open, onClose).
2. **`SortModalProps`** (sort-modal.tsx:12) — same pattern, no JSDoc on exported interface.
3. **`aggregation.ts`** — four exported functions (setSubtotalGrandTotal, setSubtotalSpacer, setSubtotalOnTop, setSubtotalStrategy) lack individual JSDoc. They are one-line setters whose intent is obvious from the name. File-level doc covers the module.

### Accuracy check:
- All parameter counts and types in docstrings match implementations
- Return type documentation is accurate
- Phase references in docstrings (P8-S1, P8-S5, etc.) correctly describe current implementation
- ASR-0002 compliance noted in join-key-pair.tsx, join-options-popup.tsx, band-config-modal.tsx
- Feature-mapping.md design document references are consistent with implementation
- No stale documentation found — all docs reflect current architecture

### Observations:
- Project convention is file-level JSDoc describing component purpose, with function-level JSDoc added for non-trivial exports. This is consistently applied.
- Internal/private helpers (e.g., `_displayLabel()`, `_saveResultColState()`, `removeTable()`, `formatRowCount()`) are well-documented even though not required per project conventions.
- Pattern of documenting ASR compliance cross-references in user-facing component docs is used consistently across join/band components.

title: Live Chip-Table UI: Documentation analysis complete
body: Performed comprehensive documentation coverage analysis for 20+ changed files in the Live Chip-Table UI feature (Integration Gate). All React components (17+) have JSDoc coverage via file-level or function-level comments. Found 9 minor gaps: 5 exported prop interfaces missing JSDoc (LayoutModalProps, FilterModalProps, SortModalProps, StacksModalProps, BandConfigModalProps) and 4 simple aggregation helper functions missing JSDoc (setSubtotalGrandTotal, setSubtotalSpacer, setSubtotalOnTop, setSubtotalStrategy). No stale or misleading documentation detected. Feature mapping design doc is consistent with implementation. Tier: MINOR_ISSUES_PASS — log gaps but do not dispatch.
